name: media_audit_events
description: Append-only record of a media item's lifecycle changes, with the acting member or none for the processor and maintenance.
lifecycle: Inserted in the same transaction as the change it records; never updated or deleted at runtime. Retention follows the company (provisional until PH-13).

columns.Null meaning: The processor or maintenance made the change.

columns.Meaning: Membership through which the change was made.
columns.Null meaning: The processor or maintenance made the change.

columns.Meaning: Event name such as media.uploaded, media.ready, media.archived or media.purged.
Allowlisted IDs, kinds, sizes, states and reason codes; never names of other items, hashes or paths.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (actor_principal_id) REFERENCES principals(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The actor is a known principal.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, actor_membership_id) REFERENCES memberships(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The acting membership belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, asset_id) REFERENCES media_assets(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The item belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: An event belongs to an existing company.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX media_audit_events_asset_time_idx ON public.media_audit_events USING btree (company_id, asset_id, occurred_at DESC, id DESC)
constraints.Purpose: Reads an item's history newest first.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX media_audit_events_company_id_id_key ON public.media_audit_events USING btree (company_id, id)
